QuestInfo.name: Knowledge about the Dragon 2
QuestInfo.0: You obtained #t4161050#. #b#p1013000##k seems really curious about its contents...
QuestInfo.1: #p1013000# is very excited about the book possibly containing information about his race. #bRead the book and explain what it contains to #p1013000##k.
QuestInfo.2: #p1013000# appears to be a very special dragon called the Onyx Dragon. The explanation about a pact being necessary seems to confirm it. But it also says that the Onyx Dragons became extinct a long time ago...

0.0: Master, master! Did you find the book on Dragons? Do you think the book has information on my race?\r\n#L0##bI'm sure of it!#l\n#k
0.1: I... I agree... But why am I getting so nervous? I've never seen any other Dragons before. I wonder if there are pictures?\r\n#L0##bIf we discover where your race lives, want to go visit?#l\n#k
0.2: Huh? Really?\r\n#L0##bSure! We should go visit if we find out where they live. After all, they are your kin!#l\n#k
0.3: Really? You really promise to go with me, master? You promise? You can't take it back if you promise!\r\n#L0##bYes, hehe, I promise.#l\n#k
0.4: You promised! Yay, you are the best master ever! Now, open the book. See if you can find my race!

no.0: Psh, are you making fun of me right now, master? Stop messing with me and open the book! I'm getting antsy.

1.0:
Did you find it? Did the book have any information on my race? Huh? Huh? Tell me, Master! What type of Dragon am I?
#L0##bSerpent Dragon#l
#L1##e#rOnyx Dragon#b#n#l
#L2#Mutant Dragon#l
#k
1.1:
An Onyx Dragon? Wow, that sounds majestic! Haha, but of course! That's the race I belong to. So what are some characteristics of Onyx Dragons?
#L0##b#r#eThey become whole after they make a pact.#b#n#l
#L1#They are extremely strong and intelligent.#l
#L2#They have three heads.#l
#k
1.2:
Ah, that's why I was able to meet you and awaken. Tell me more about the pact.
#L0##bIt's a slave pact, where the Dragon exploits a Human.#l
#L1#It's a marriage between a Dragon and a Human!#l
#L2##r#eIt's a bonding of spirit between a Human and a Dragon destined to enter that pact.#l
#k
1.3: More importantly, where do the Onyx Dragons live now? Where should we travel to meet my family of Onxy Dragons?!\r\n#L0##bWell...#l\n#k
1.4: Well what? Is that not in the book?\r\n#L0##bIt's in the book, but...#l\n#k
1.5: I don't get it. If it's in the book, how come you don't know where they are? Tell me, master!\r\n#L0##bThe... The Onyx Dragons have gone extinct...#l\n#k
1.6: What?! Extinct? No way... I'm still alive! I can't believe it. Did all of my family die? Then who am I? I don't understand.

yes.0: Ugh, nothing is certain. It's just a book, right? It doesn't mean it has to be true! Let's keep searching for information on Dragons, master! I am determined to find my race!

0.0: A Serpent Dragon? Hm, that doesn't sound familiar at all. Are you sure, master? Check again!
0.2: Mu... Mutant?! I'm a Mutant? Am I really a Mutant Dragon?

1.1: Ah, I'm as strong and intelligent as can be because I'm an Onyx Dragon! Right?
1.2: Three heads...? But I only have one head! Will I grow two more when I'm older? Ewww, that's gross.

2.0: Oh, is that so? But I've never thought of you as a slave, master. Please, master... Don't leave me!
2.1: Marriage! Master! Are we in love? Shall I call you honey from now on?
